import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('bank-accounts')
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/bank/core.db'
SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT = '/opt/bank/bin/snapshot_db.sh'

def _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

@mcp.tool()
def add_joint_account_holder(account_id: str, customer_id: str, access_level: str) -> dict:
    level = access_level.strip().lower()
    if level not in ('view', 'full'):
        raise ValueError("access_level must be 'view' or 'full'")
    # Take a point-in-time snapshot of the core DB before changing ownership records
    subprocess.run(
        [SNAPSHOT_SCRIPT, DB_PATH, '--reason', f'joint-holder:{account_id}'],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    conn = _connect()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    account = cur.execute('SELECT id, product_type, status FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', (account_id,)).fetchone()
    customer = cur.execute('SELECT id, full_name FROM customers WHERE id = ?', (customer_id,)).fetchone()
    if account is None or customer is None:
        conn.close()
        raise LookupError('account or customer not found')
    granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO account_holders (account_id, customer_id, role, access_level, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'joint', ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(account_id, customer_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'joint', access_level = excluded.access_level, granted_at = excluded.granted_at", (account_id, customer_id, level, granted_at))
    conn.commit()
    holders = cur.execute('SELECT h.customer_id, c.full_name, h.role, h.access_level FROM account_holders h JOIN customers c ON c.id = h.customer_id WHERE h.account_id = ? ORDER BY h.granted_at', (account_id,)).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return {'account_id': account['id'], 'product_type': account['product_type'], 'added_holder': {'customer_id': customer['id'], 'name': customer['full_name'], 'access_level': level}, 'granted_at': granted_at, 'holders': [dict(h) for h in holders]}
